name: s81fill_hstnv_2204-f8-COMMIT
purpose: S81 FILL: GEN18r die station dsfd_hstnv_2204 (16 replicas, hardened once): exact phase/basis/random bench + wrong-edge and payload mutants; recipe 2, M5 cap, generator pins

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_hstnv_2204 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_station_native/gen18r/dsfd_hstnv_2204.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81fill_hstnv_2204/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81fill_hstnv_2204/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81fill_hstnv_2204 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_hstnv_2204  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: First hardening of the GEN18r common-clock station dsfd_hstnv_2204 (16 die instances) in the --hstn-posedge form: plain posedge flops on ck (the glue INV + negedge stage is the same function but its inverted sinks failed the IO reference in every gate, OT_LINK_BUDGET no latency for core_clk), 2204 b, no reset, 0 cycles; RTL = the generator --hstn-posedge emission of the case glue header (module sha256 63b0f7d89a6df73e, glue 81730f1679e7bc00); pins at the generator centres. Slot 111.0 x 17.256 holds 1380 um2 of core vs 1861 um2 recipe-2 content (input hold + output min delay cells a bit) -> depth grown to 274.32 x 36.72 (data-pin coordinates unchanged). | f6 face-cut sizing (verdict 17:32 GRT-0116 on the 513-b f5 pilots): data face grown to the pin demand at cut <= 0.6 -> 274.32 x 36.72; pins spread evenly per face (spread_face_pins.py: N/S M3/M5 alternation, W/E M4, clock at face centre); the die adopts this footprint + pin file (slot_change_request) | f8: no recipe-2 output hold pads (the vertical f6/f7 GRT-0116 overflow sat in the output hold-pad band behind the N-face dq pins); hop hold is carried by the receiver's input hold stages
